# Golden export fixtures

Files in this directory are the **expected exporter output**, committed so the
writer tests can compare byte for byte without ever reading `OpenFOAM-v2206/` at
run time.

## `cavity/system/fvSolution`

- Origin: generated by `FvSolutionWriter` from the v2206 snapshot
  `../foam/cavity/system/fvSolution`, then reviewed by hand.
- Why it differs from the source: the tutorial merges the `p` solver into
  `pFinal` with `$p;`, the exporter expands the merge
  (`docs/DECISIONS.md` D-033), so `pFinal` spells out
  `solver`/`preconditioner`/`tolerance` plus its own `relTol`.
- Everything else is byte identical to the source snapshot: `0/p`, `0/U`,
  `system/blockMeshDict`, `system/controlDict`, `system/fvSchemes`,
  `constant/transportProperties` are compared directly against `../foam/cavity/`
  by `tests/io/CaseWriterGoldenTest.cpp`.

## Maintenance

- Regenerate only when the writer output changes **intentionally**, and record
  the reason in `docs/DECISIONS.md`.
- Line endings are LF, UTF-8 without BOM, exactly one trailing newline.
